name: workspace.agents
title: Show connected agents
summary: The clients connected to this working copy through the MCP server, each with when it connected, and the client connected last; whether the cache folder of the copy records connections at all.

recorded.title: Recorded
recorded.description: Whether the copy has a usable cache folder whose connections could be read (ADR-0008). false when the workspace has no cache folder, the cache folder lies inside a repository of the workspace, or it cannot be read; then both lists are empty.

connected.title: Connected agents
connected.description: Each MCP server process of this copy whose client is connected now, the one connected first first. Calls through the API or the command line and MCP servers of another workspace or copy never count.

since.title: Connected since
since.description: When the client connected: when the MCP server answered its `initialize`, or, in protocol revision 2026-07-28, when its first request arrived.

last.title: Last connected
last.description: The connection that ended last, also by a crash; null when none has ended. With `connected` empty and `last` null, no agent was connected to this copy as far as its cache folder knows.

at.title: Last connected at
at.description: When it was connected last: its end, or after a crash the last time its process showed it was running.
